working_features: pygame window opens and displays a grid-based playing field
snake appears on the grid and can be controlled with arrow keys
snake moves continuously in the current direction at a steady pace
food spawns at a random unoccupied position on the grid
snake grows longer by one segment when it eats food
score counter is displayed on screen and increments when food is eaten
game ends when the snake collides with the wall boundaries
game ends when the snake collides with its own body
game over screen is displayed with the final score
game can be restarted by pressing a key after game over
